Pens: eBay sold 'Parker 51 grey lustraloy fountain pen' and 'Parker 51 aerometric cap steel' (nib size and condition; a plain steel-cap 51 is usually modest).
viewing_check: Case back: reference number and serial (confirm genuine Omega, ladies 1316/158 or similar); whether crown winds and the rotor sounds, and whether it runs for a few minutes; crystal cracks and dial lume/spotting; bracelet stretch and clasp stamp. Pens: nib marking (14K or 18K gold nib on the grey 51 adds value), cap imprint, any cracks in the barrel, whether the second pen is really Parker. Necklace: any hallmark (925).
